notes: The ground this area owns: the university's land south of Normal Avenue and west of Valley Road, plus Valley Road itself from the Normal Avenue junction to the campus's south corner. Places inside (names from the university where known, positions from OpenStreetMap, the 2020 ortho and the LiDAR): Lot 1 and Lot 2, President's Drive and President's Drive Extension, the Van Reyper-Bond House (Bond House, 848 Valley Road, on the National Register), the President's House, Legge House (860 Valley Road), Coder House (10 Normal Avenue), the Center for Autism and Early Childhood Mental Health (14 Normal Avenue), the university houses at 18, 20 and 22 Normal Avenue (unnamed in OSM), a small university building at (-162..-151, -360..-351) (OSM 232846628, unnamed), and Valley Road (a county road, not campus ground) with its east sidewalk. The area name 'normal' is a label only: Normal Avenue itself is not in it. North: 0.2 m under the south edge of the main model's Normal Avenue hand work (WS110_NormalAve_sidewalk, and its carriageway at the College Avenue mouth), fitted from the published triangles (west run, arc r 37.4 at (-96.74, -318.61), arc r 2.1 at (-83.09, -323.77), east run; fit error median 0.004 m, max 0.20 m), from x -256 to the sidewalk's south-east corner at the junction; then 0.2 m under the main carriageway's east cut (-60.9, -334.6)-(-53.7, -319.9), straight across the junction gap to the main model's north piece (WS110 carriageway and sidewalk at x -57..-41, y -294..-311) and 0.2 m under its south sidewalk edge, then east along y -310.45 to the back of Valley Road's east sidewalk. East: 2.5 m east of the centre of Valley Road's east sidewalk (1.75 m behind its back edge), one straight run. South: square across Valley Road 110 m south of the fitted frame origin, then the OSM campus line north-west to 3 to 4 m outside Lot 1's south-west corner. West: 3 m or more outside Lot 1's west edge and the west drive (ortho2020), then the OSM campus line between the drive and the backyards of the private houses on College Avenue (kept 4 m or more from their walls, LiDAR), 2.5 m south of 22 Normal Avenue's south eaves and 2.7 m north of the private house south-west of it, and north at x -256 to Normal Avenue. Left out: Normal Avenue (main model hand work, not to be touched); 30 Normal Avenue (university, west of College Avenue); College Avenue south of Normal Avenue and its private houses; the slip lane and pork-chop island north of the main model's Normal Avenue at the junction (x -91..-55, y -320..-300: skirt, but bounded on all sides by main-model meshes; left to whoever reworks the main junction); Valley Road north of y -310 and the mouth of Normal Avenue's east leg (main pieces, WS134 lawn patch and skirt); Mount Hebron Cemetery. Open risks: the main model's Normal Avenue is rotated against the 2020 ortho (its south curb about 1 m north of the ortho's at x -232 and about 5 m south of it at x -160), and its junction pieces lie over Valley Road's lanes, 3 to 5 m off the ortho; this area meets them where they are. No building, fence, paving or instanced object of another model lies inside, except the 0.2 m tucks under Normal Avenue's sidewalk and carriageway (42 and 2 m2). Steps at the cuts across Valley Road (2026-11-21): the published neighbour there is coarse ground off the LiDAR road (north cut, y -310.45, x -47 to -34: the skirt 0.9 to 1.4 m under it; south cut, x -179 to -163: BD_farfield 0.9 to 1.8 m over it), so the plain edge rule left a step of that size. edge_heights.json is now read from the published tiles 0.3 m outside the footprint, and the engine's road-cut rule (README, Road cuts) ramps Valley Road, its sidewalks and the drives marked road to the neighbour at the edge. Measured on a build (5 cm each side of the outline): north cut median 0.03 m, south cut median 0.03 m; the east sidewalk at the north cut (x -38 to -36) still 0.5 to 1.0 m, the President's Drive mouth on Normal Avenue 0.27 m.

supersede.notes: Patterns match 'mesh name material name' in the other sources' tiles. clip: their ground inside the footprint (triangle area inside the outline, m2, from a dump of the published tiles: Context_skirt_3DEP_ortho_4km 33371, BD_farfield_3DEP 8812, WS110_ground_patch.001 (COLE_lawn_post2020_bs, a draped lawn patch south of Normal Avenue) 1160, MH_terrain_apron_3m (MH_ground_ortho2020) 30, WS114_terrain_fan_fill_S_edge_DTM1m 4.7). Clip, not drop: all of them run on beyond the outline. drop: far_houses (far_houses_osm blocks of the eight university houses inside, 1216 m2; the buildings zone rebuilds them; no private house's block is inside). WS110_NormalAve_sidewalk, _carriageway, _curb and _verge are not listed: the outline reaches 0.2 m under them so their paving covers the joint.
